description: Toroidal DualMode settle-bound stress configs. The stationary weight-load settle is chainLen - outerPe*, so it is ZERO whenever the released local dimension is 1 (outerPe* == chainLen) — the stock 5.toroidal_dual_mode.json configs are therefore a weak test of the settle bound. These configs push the other way: one outer cluster with all the chain depth inside it (lvR/lvC = chainLen), which maximises settle (= chainLen - 1) and so exposes any off-by-one in the bound. ReuseB contracts down rows (chainLen = outerPeRow*localPeRow, outer = outerPeRow); ReuseA is the column mirror.
